note: walk-forward: each day's weights use only signals available that day; returns realized over the following session. 60d warm-up excluded.

turnover_study.finding: In the 2022 downtrend, responsiveness beat cost savings: the high-turnover variant de-risked falling names faster and outperformed the low-turnover variant by +9.3pts. Turnover calibration is regime-dependent - documented rather than hidden.

interpretation: Walk-forward over 510 trading days (2021-08 to 2022-12), the 2022 bear market: the sentiment tilt beat its cap-weight benchmark by +4.8pts net of 10bps turnover costs (−51.2% vs −56.0%) while trailing equal-weight. Honest read: the tilt added value against the index it rebalances; equal-weight benefited from the year's small-cap skew; turnover remains the binding constraint.
